plugins.name: design-doc
plugins.description: Turn a requirement into a verifiable, implementation-ready detailed design document (SDD). Interrogates ambiguity first, then produces a design contract.

plugins.name: skill-authoring
plugins.description: House conventions and template for writing, improving, and reviewing Claude Code skills, plus this marketplace's registration flow (marketplace.json entry, version bump, local dedup).

plugins.name: flutter-dart-code-review
plugins.description: Library-agnostic Flutter/Dart code review checklist: widget best practices, state management, Dart idioms, performance, accessibility, security, clean architecture.

plugins.name: claude-md-hygiene
plugins.description: Audit or rewrite a project's agent-facing CLAUDE.md/AGENTS.md so it stays stable norms + landmines only — push volatile status/todos/contract/design detail out to living docs, keep only invariants + pointers, and grep-verify every referenced symbol still exists.

plugins.name: sdd-harness-init
plugins.description: Scaffold the decision-log drift-guard SDD harness into a repo — create docs/design/DECISIONS.md, install a warn-only pre-commit that lists un-written-back decisions, wire git core.hooksPath, and inject a CLAUDE.md pointer section. Idempotent; the portable mechanism is contract-agnostic (writeback targets stay per-project).

plugins.name: claim-check
plugins.description: Install a Stop hook that checks the agent's own claims against the tool calls it actually made — whether something is really running, whether "tests green" predates the last edit, whether a conclusion drawn under challenge was preceded by actually opening the file in question.

plugins.name: handoff
plugins.description: Before compacting or starting a fresh session, capture what the next session cannot look up — pending decisions, rejected paths and why, measured numbers, and what was claimed but never verified — and mechanically inventory the working tree and anything still running.

plugins.name: arch-guard
plugins.description: Lock a layered architecture's dependency direction into a repo with a warn-only pre-commit — declare the layer order in a config, then git grep flags upward imports, feature→feature deps, and cross-layer violations (--strict for CI). Language/package-agnostic; complements sdd-harness-init on the same hook.

plugins.name: teammate
plugins.description: 多 agent(teammate)協作的房規與派工令樣板:開幾個由視角決定、派工令必備六條、報告收不到的處理、stop 的前提、review 期間的 baseline 紀律、規格中途變更的重派流程。

plugins.name: release-assets
plugins.description: Ship the non-code deliverables cleanly: release notes, store screenshots, changelog, version bump. Inventory first, understand what you replace, review as the audience, leave no residue.

plugins.name: comment-budget
plugins.description: Warn-only pre-commit guard on comment volume: over-long blocks, per-file comment ratio, and narrative/verification-process wording. Comments should say what the code cannot; history goes to git log, verification goes to the commit message.

plugins.name: harness-audit
plugins.description: Audit which guard-rail harnesses a repo should have, which are installed, and which are missing — then prove each one actually fires by injecting a violation.

plugins.name: greenfield-flow
plugins.description: Ordering and entry conditions for a 0→1 project: when to converge the requirement, when to lay the foundation, when NOT to install guards yet, and when review and shipping are due.
